title: International Conference on Mechanobiology
about: The 2nd International Conference on Mechanobiology, organised by Elsevier with the journal Mechanobiology in Medicine, takes place 22 to 25 July 2027 at Qianhai Block V, Shenzhen, China. Abstract submission closes 19 February 2027.
card_alt: EduCut Connect card for the International Conference on Mechanobiology, organised by Elsevier in Shenzhen, China; abstract deadline 19 Feb 2027. The photo shows the gate of Shuhe Ancient Town in Lijiang, China, not Shenzhen.
